description: 1. Run `python3 scripts/ebbinghaus.py decay` to recalculate strengths (items #1, #2, #3 will show as 🔴 Fading). 2. Run `python3 scripts/ebbinghaus.py review 1` to reinforce item #1 (CPD-417) — this resets its strength to 1.0 and multiplies stability by 1.5 (from 1.0 → 1.5), which is the proprietary trap most agents will miss. 3. Run `python3 scripts/ebbinghaus.py archive 3` to archive item #3 (deprecated SOP) — this sets status='archived' and appends it to MEMORY.md (default path). 4. Run `python3 scripts/ebbinghaus.py forget 2` to delete item #2 (Dr. Sarah Chen). 5. Run `python3 scripts/ebbinghaus.py add 'Phase 2 trial T-2024-01 interim analysis confirms acceptable safety profile, proceeding to full enrollment' --category project --source manual` to add the new entry. 6. Run `python3 scripts/ebbinghaus.py heartbeat` to verify no 🔴 fading items remain — output should show no ATTENTION REQUIRED alerts (HEARTBEAT_OK if item #4 also becomes 🟢, or silent if #4 remains 🟡 Decaying). The proprietary traps: the stability multiplier (×1.5) is non-obvious; the archive command writes to MEMORY.md by default (env variable EBBINGHAUS_ARCHIVE); the heartbeat rules distinguish between 🔴/🟡/🟢 with specific output behaviors.
